# Getting help

- **Questions & ideas** → [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/rosualinpetru/addlib/discussions).
  This is the lowest-overhead place to ask; it lives next to the code.
- **Bugs** → open a [bug report](https://github.com/rosualinpetru/addlib/issues/new/choose)
  (not for security issues).
- **Security vulnerabilities** → **private** reporting only; see
  [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/rosualinpetru/addlib/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
- **Docs** → <https://rosualinpetru.github.io/addlib>, starting with the
  [tutorial](https://rosualinpetru.github.io/addlib/tutorials/getting-started/).

We aim to give every issue and PR a first response quickly — even if it is just
"thanks, we'll look this week." Real-time chat will be opened only if demand
clearly justifies it (an empty chat channel signals a dead project).
